schema_name: EngineGuard AI nine-sensor synthetic feature contract V2

source_contract.role: approved V1 reference only, not a V2 producer revision

data_scope: V2 feature contract and synthetic-only prototyping; no V2 training data currently exists.

metadata_semantics.availability: Boolean acquisition indicators. False means unavailable and corresponding features must be null/NaN; a numeric zero is a valid measurement when availability is true.
metadata_semantics.source_commit: Required nonempty exact source revision identifier.

legacy_feature_semantics.crank_rpm_std: V2 complete crank-revolution RPM population standard deviation
